def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)
    idx = pd.Index(list(entity_ids), name="product_id")

    # --- покупки: используем ts (момент покупки заказа) ---
    items = order_items[["order_id", "product_id", "price", "freight_value", "ts"]].copy()
    items = items[items["ts"] < seed_time]

    # --- платежи: учитываем только те, что уже проведены к seed_time ---
    pay = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time]
    pay_agg = pay.groupby("order_id").agg(
        payment_sum=("payment_value", "sum"),
        payment_max=("payment_value", "max"),
        installments_mean=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        n_payments=("payment_sequential", "count"),
    ).reset_index()

    # --- отзывы: видимы только если отзыв уже опубликован (answer) к seed_time ---
    rev = reviews[reviews["review_answer_timestamp"] < seed_time]
    rev_agg = rev.groupby("order_id").agg(
        review_score_mean=("review_score", "mean"),
        review_score_min=("review_score", "min"),
        review_score_max=("review_score", "max"),
        review_count=("review_id", "count"),
        review_has_text=("review_comment_message", lambda s: s.notna().any()),
    ).reset_index()

    df = items.merge(pay_agg, on="order_id", how="left").merge(rev_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
    df["days_before"] = (seed_time - df["ts"]).dt.days
    df = df[df["product_id"].isin(idx)]

    windows = [7, 30, 90, 365]

    def empty_block(suffix):
        cols = {
            f"count_{suffix}": 0.0, f"qty_{suffix}": 0.0,
            f"sum_price_{suffix}": 0.0, f"mean_price_{suffix}": 0.0, f"max_price_{suffix}": 0.0,
            f"sum_freight_{suffix}": 0.0, f"mean_freight_{suffix}": 0.0,
            f"revenue_{suffix}": 0.0, f"mean_revenue_{suffix}": 0.0,
            f"sum_payment_{suffix}": 0.0, f"mean_payment_{suffix}": 0.0,
            f"mean_installments_{suffix}": 0.0, f"mean_n_payments_{suffix}": 0.0,
            f"mean_review_{suffix}": 0.0, f"min_review_{suffix}": 0.0, f"max_review_{suffix}": 0.0,
            f"n_reviews_{suffix}": 0.0, f"pos_review_ratio_{suffix}": 0.0,
            f"neg_review_ratio_{suffix}": 0.0, f"text_review_ratio_{suffix}": 0.0,
        }
        return pd.DataFrame(cols, index=idx)

    frames = []
    for w in windows:
        sub = df[df["days_before"] < w]
        if sub.empty:
            frames.append(empty_block(f"{w}d"))
            continue
        g = sub.groupby("product_id").agg(
            count=("order_id", "nunique"),
            qty=("price", "size"),
            sum_price=("price", "sum"),
            mean_price=("price", "mean"),
            max_price=("price", "max"),
            sum_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
            mean_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
            revenue=("payment_sum", "sum"),
            mean_revenue=("payment_sum", "mean"),
            sum_payment=("payment_max", "sum"),
            mean_payment=("payment_max", "mean"),
            mean_installments=("installments_mean", "mean"),
            mean_n_payments=("n_payments", "mean"),
            mean_review=("review_score_mean", "mean"),
            min_review=("review_score_min", "min"),
            max_review=("review_score_max", "max"),
            n_reviews=("review_count", "sum"),
        )
        per_item = sub[["product_id", "review_score_mean", "review_has_text"]].copy()
        per_item["pos"] = (per_item["review_score_mean"] >= 4).astype(float)
        per_item["neg"] = (per_item["review_score_mean"] <= 2).astype(float)
        per_item["txt"] = per_item["review_has_text"].astype(float)
        ratios = per_item.groupby("product_id")[["pos", "neg", "txt"]].mean()
        g = g.join(ratios).rename(columns={
            "pos": f"pos_review_ratio_{w}d",
            "neg": f"neg_review_ratio_{w}d",
            "txt": f"text_review_ratio_{w}d",
        })
        g.index.name = "product_id"
        frames.append(g.reindex(idx).fillna(0.0))

    features = pd.concat(frames, axis=1)

    # --- глобальные (за всё время) признаки ---
    if df.empty:
        feats_all = empty_block("all")
        trend_count = pd.Series(0.0, index=idx)
        trend_price = pd.Series(0.0, index=idx)
        age_days = pd.Series(0.0, index=idx)
        recency_days = pd.Series(9999.0, index=idx)
        n_sellers = pd.Series(0.0, index=idx)
    else:
        g = df.groupby("product_id").agg(
            count=("order_id", "nunique"),
            qty=("price", "size"),
            sum_price=("price", "sum"),
            mean_price=("price", "mean"),
            max_price=("price", "max"),
            sum_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
            mean_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
            revenue=("payment_sum", "sum"),
            mean_revenue=("payment_sum", "mean"),
            sum_payment=("payment_max", "sum"),
            mean_payment=("payment_max", "mean"),
            mean_installments=("installments_mean", "mean"),
            mean_n_payments=("n_payments", "mean"),
            mean_review=("review_score_mean", "mean"),
            min_review=("review_score_min", "min"),
            max_review=("review_score_max", "max"),
            n_reviews=("review_count", "sum"),
        )
        per_item = df[["product_id", "review_score_mean", "review_has_text"]].copy()
        per_item["pos"] = (per_item["review_score_mean"] >= 4).astype(float)
        per_item["neg"] = (per_item["review_score_mean"] <= 2).astype(float)
        per_item["txt"] = per_item["review_has_text"].astype(float)
        ratios = per_item.groupby("product_id")[["pos", "neg", "txt"]].mean()
        feats_all = g.join(ratios).rename(columns={
            "pos": "pos_review_ratio_all",
            "neg": "neg_review_ratio_all",
            "txt": "text_review_ratio_all",
        })
        feats_all.index.name = "product_id"
        feats_all = feats_all.reindex(idx).fillna(0.0)

        # тренд: продажи за последние 30 дней минус за предыдущие 30 дней
        cur = df[df["days_before"] < 30].groupby("product_id").agg(
            c=("order_id", "nunique"), p=("price", "sum"))
        prev = df[(df["days_before"] >= 30) & (df["days_before"] < 60)].groupby("product_id").agg(
            c=("order_id", "nunique"), p=("price", "sum"))
        trend_count = (cur["c"].reindex(idx).fillna(0) - prev["c"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)).astype(float)
        trend_price = (cur["p"].reindex(idx).fillna(0) - prev["p"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)).astype(float)

        first_sale = df.groupby("product_id")["ts"].min()
        last_sale = df.groupby("product_id")["ts"].max()
        age_days = ((seed_time - first_sale).dt.days).reindex(idx).fillna(0).astype(float)
        recency_days = ((seed_time - last_sale).dt.days).reindex(idx).fillna(9999).astype(float)
        n_sellers = df.groupby("product_id")["order_id"].count()  # placeholder to keep dtype
        n_sellers = df.drop_duplicates(["product_id", "order_id"]).merge(
            order_items[["order_id", "seller_id"]].drop_duplicates(), on="order_id", how="left"
        ).groupby("product_id")["seller_id"].nunique().reindex(idx).fillna(0).astype(float)

    features = pd.concat([features, feats_all], axis=1)
    features["count_trend_30d"] = trend_count
    features["sum_price_trend_30d"] = trend_price
    features["age_days"] = age_days
    features["recency_days"] = recency_days
    features["n_sellers"] = n_sellers

    features = features.reindex(idx)
    features = features.fillna(0.0).astype(float)
    return features
